title: Israel heads to polls for pivotal election defined by security and democracy
description: Many fear neither of the leading political blocs will win enough seats for a majority - meaning weeks or months of political wrangling may lie ahead.

title: Chancellor to cut tariffs on marmalade and other products to help with cost-of-living
description: The BBC understands the government will also freeze fuel duty again in the Budget.

title: Kane ends England’s 25-year wait to win men’s Ballon d’Or award
description: Harry Kane becomes the first English player to win the prize since Michael Owen in 2001, and Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas wins the Ballon d’Or Feminin for a record-equalling third time.

title: 'A dream come true' - Harry Kane on his Ballon d'Or win
description: It's the first time an English player has lifted the trophy since Michael Owen in 2001.

title: Ex-FBI chief James Comey faces federal charges for third time
description: Comey's lawyers say the case stems from alleged disclosure of classified information to the New York Times in 2016.

title: Rise in sales of radios and tinned foods, say retailers, after call to stock up
description: Figures obtained by BBC Newsnight show large spikes in sales of torches, radios and power banks.

title: Major Chinese brands drop Mbappé as backlash grows over Mao joke
description: He allegedly said his "favourite meme" is "the one where they put my face on a Chinese dictator".

title: Storm Boelo leaves thousands without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
description: A yellow warning for strong winds came in effect at 18:00 on Monday across the west coast of England, Wales and Scotland and eastern parts of Northern Ireland.

title: Jay-Z to perform at Super Bowl half-time show
description: The rapper has been involved with the show for years but has never before performed at the NFL championship game.
